path.aria-label: Resource accounting, useful throughput and timing · quantities are derived at runtime
Each cold triplet uses 3 logical slots.
Up to 2 slots per cold triplet.
Pending eligible bytes = O − S − B. Count occupied and pending backing slots once.
Use the lesser logical/backing triplet allowance after 15% reserves and worker memory charges.
Resident ratio = L / C; excluding same-element = (L − S) / C
Useful MiB/s = Δ verified bytes / (elapsed s × 1,048,576)
Separate backing MiB/s from bd_stat read deltas.
CPU busy target: 80%; tuning windows ≥ 30 s.
Stage CPU = summed thread execution time.
Summed stage wall times may overlap.
Phase evidence, errors, capacity and compression.
Tuning decisions, thread history and timing.
Raw counter names retained in CSV.
Device-wide, non-atomic counters; backing-slot model is conditional on kernel behavior. Rates are diagnostic, not benchmark guarantees.
